name: M365Gov_NativeAlerts

authoritativeControlOwner.name: Originating Microsoft security or compliance product

nativePortalRoute.label: Microsoft Defender portal alerts
nativePortalRoute.notes: SecurityIncident rows route to Microsoft Sentinel because incident URLs are workspace-specific.

dependencies.name: SecurityAlert
dependencies.owner: Microsoft Defender XDR and integrated native alert providers

freshness.expected: Connector-dependent; commonly minutes, but not guaranteed.

limitations: An absent alert does not mean an absent risk or compliance event.
SecurityIncident is an investigation container and does not transfer authoritative control ownership.
ActorIdentifier is populated only when a native alert supplies CompromisedEntity.

missingSourceBehavior.description: The fuzzy union returns available sources. If neither table resolves, validation flags the function unavailable instead of treating the result as no risk.

privacy.identityHandling: Only the native compromised-entity identifier is exposed for correlation.
